_source.title: 尺寸标注坐标集
_source.remarks.text.0: 尺寸标注坐标集存在以下三种 {@link EPCB_PrimitiveDimensionType | 尺寸标注类型}：
_source.remarks.text.5: - `{number}` `x2` - 标注线尾部的端点 X
_source.remarks.text.6: - `{number}` `y2` - 标注线尾部的端点 Y
_source.remarks.text.7: - `{number}` `x3` - 标注文字的左下端点 X
_source.remarks.text.8: - `{number}` `y3` - 标注文字的左下端点 Y
_source.remarks.text.13: - `{number}` `x2` - 第一标注箭头端点 X
_source.remarks.text.14: - `{number}` `y2` - 第一标注箭头端点 Y
_source.remarks.text.15: - `{number}` `x3` - 第二标注箭头端点 X
_source.remarks.text.16: - `{number}` `y3` - 第二标注箭头端点 Y

title: Dimension coordinate set
remarks.text.0: The dimension coordinate set has the following three {@link EPCB_PrimitiveDimensionType | dimension types}:
remarks.text.3: - `{number}` `x1` - X of the endpoint on the circle/arc
remarks.text.4: - `{number}` `y1` - Y of the endpoint on the circle/arc
remarks.text.5: - `{number}` `x2` - X of the endpoint at the tail of the dimension line
remarks.text.6: - `{number}` `y2` - Y of the endpoint at the tail of the dimension line
remarks.text.7: - `{number}` `x3` - X of the bottom-left endpoint of the dimension text
remarks.text.8: - `{number}` `y3` - Y of the bottom-left endpoint of the dimension text
remarks.text.11: - `{number}` `x1` - X of the first measurement endpoint
remarks.text.12: - `{number}` `y1` - Y of the first measurement endpoint
remarks.text.13: - `{number}` `x2` - X of the first dimension arrow endpoint
remarks.text.14: - `{number}` `y2` - Y of the first dimension arrow endpoint
remarks.text.15: - `{number}` `x3` - X of the second dimension arrow endpoint
remarks.text.16: - `{number}` `y3` - Y of the second dimension arrow endpoint
remarks.text.17: - `{number}` `x4` - X of the second measurement endpoint
remarks.text.18: - `{number}` `y4` - Y of the second measurement endpoint
remarks.text.21: - `{number}` `x1` - X of the first side endpoint
remarks.text.22: - `{number}` `y1` - Y of the first side endpoint
remarks.text.25: - `{number}` `x3` - X of the second side endpoint
remarks.text.26: - `{number}` `y3` - Y of the second side endpoint
